info.title: Merchant App payment API
info.description:
Merchant App payment endpoints served by shop-app BizPaymentController (@Profile api). Source of truth: Java code (BizPaymentController -> BizPaymentAppService (embedded BizPaymentAppServiceImpl -> PayBizFacade, or standalone RemoteBizPaymentAppService -> near-pay /internal/pay/v1/biz) and PaymentReadRouter).

Auth: Authorization: Bearer <merchant btk_ token>.

Store: the controller never takes a store from the path/body; it uses BizContext.requireStoreNo(), i.e. the store selected by the X-Store-No header (BizContextFilter; an unauthorized value silently falls back to the default store). /biz/payment/** is a registered store-member route (ShopStoreMemberRoutes): for new-model stores a missing X-Store-No is rejected by admission with HTTP 403 {code:70006,data:{nextAction:'SELECT_STORE'}}, a non-member/missing capability with 70006 + CONTACT_ADMIN. If no store can be resolved at all requireStoreNo() returns 10403. Treat X-Store-No as required.

Envelope: {code,msg,data}; code 0 = success. Business errors are returned as HTTP 200 with a non-zero code (except admission rejections above and 401). Codes used here: 10400 bad request, 10403 forbidden (also @PreAuthorize denial), 10404 not found / not this store, 70006 store admission, 70083 pay order not found, 70084 refund idempotency conflict, 70085 pay order state, 70086 refund exceeds refundable, 70093 checkout expired (reissue).

Amounts are long minor units; timestamps are UTC epoch ms; dates are store-market yyyy-MM-dd. Null fields are serialized (no NON_NULL).

Not covered here: /biz/payment/app-grant (third-party grants), /biz/payment/offline-records*, and the SSE /biz/payment/events (see biz-payment-events.openapi.json).

post.description: Permission (@PreAuthorize): mch:pay:collect. Same payOrderNo; all previous tokens revoked; expireAt may be extended to now + original link duration (capped at max-expire-minutes). Only for unpaid, open, unexpired, non-voided links, else 70093 (HTTP 200 envelope here). Not this store's link -> 10404. No request body.

XStoreNo.name: X-Store-No
XStoreNo.description: Current store. Read by BizContextFilter; all /biz/payment endpoints act on this store only. Missing -> HTTP 403 code 70006 nextAction=SELECT_STORE (new-model stores).

XPayReadEnvironment.name: X-Pay-Read-Environment
XPayReadEnvironment.description: PaymentReadRouter. Only on GET collect-status, orders, orders/summary, orders/lookup, orders/{payOrderNo}. Absent or PRODUCTION -> normal production read. Any other value -> 10400. SANDBOX -> requires sandbox read client configured (else 10403), strict re-resolution of current store/entity/permission (else 10403), and an enabled SANDBOX CHECKOUT payment_collection_source bound to this store/entity of a non-deleted TW-market entity (else 10403); reads come from near-pay via the dedicated sandbox caller and are audited as BIZ_PAY_VIEW. Never falls back to production; never merged with production data. Ignored by all write endpoints.

amountMinor.description: Amount in minor units. Must be > 0 (null is treated as 0 and rejected with 10400).

subject.description: Optional. Blank/null -> store name is used as subject. No server-side length check in CheckoutServiceImpl.

bizNo.description: Optional business document number (F&B settlement, beauty work order...). Must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$ else 10400. Written to pay_order.biz_no.

kind.description: STORE (default when null) or TABLE; anything else -> 10400

tableRef.description: Required (non-blank) when kind=TABLE; max 64 chars; ignored (stored null) for STORE

singleLimitMinor.description: Per-payment limit. null->0 which is rejected; must be >0 and <= shop.pay.qr.max-single-minor (default 500000)

dailyLimitMinor.description: Daily limit. null->0; must be >= singleLimitMinor and <= shop.pay.qr.max-daily-minor (default 5000000)

amountMinor.description: > 0 and <= refundable (paid - refunded - reserved); over -> 70086 with the available amount as arg

reason.description: Optional, <= 255 chars (else 10400). Blank is stored as '-'

outRefundNo.description: Optional idempotency key. Omitted -> server generates BZR... so each tap is a new refund. Same key + same amount returns the existing refund; same key + different amount -> 70084.

reason.description: Optional. Stored on the close as '作废付款链接：<reason>' truncated to 120 chars

token.description: Checkout token plaintext (base64url, 43 chars). Only returned here; the server stores only its SHA-256

expireAt.description: Token expiry, UTC epoch milliseconds (min(link expiry, pay order expireAt))

checkoutUrl.description: shop.pay.checkout.base-url + '/c/' + token. Use as-is for QR/share

amountMinor.description: From the pay order; null only if the order lookup failed

storeName.description: Store name snapshot on the pay order

CollectView.description: PayBizFacade.CollectView (a.k.a. PayCollectResult). All 8 fields are always serialized.

status.description: Derived: paid/partially refunded/refunded -> PAID; CLOSED with VOIDED checkout session -> VOIDED; unpaid and closed or past expireAt -> EXPIRED; else PENDING

operatorNo.description: Merchant account that created the link (no name)

LinkRow.description: MerchantCollectLinkQueryService.LinkRow. No checkoutUrl/token (only hashes are stored) - call reissue to share again.

storeCodeUrl.description: Store stand link /h5/s/{storeCode}; only the standalone near-pay deployment fills it, always null in embedded deployment

RefundStatus.description: PayRefundStatus (every value in code). Non-terminal: REQUESTED, PENDING_REVIEW (platform review, only when shop.pay.refund.review=true and a rule hits), PENDING_SECOND_REVIEW, APPROVED, DISPATCHED, OFFLINE_PENDING_PROOF. Terminal: SUCCEEDED, FAILED, REJECTED. A new refund is created as PENDING_REVIEW or APPROVED, then dispatched synchronously when not under review, so the POST response may already show DISPATCHED/SUCCEEDED/FAILED. Treat unknown values as 'other'.

payOrderId.description: Internal numeric pay_order.id. payOrderNo is NOT included in this view - map back via the payOrderNo you sent, or use GET /biz/payment/orders/{payOrderNo} whose refunds[] are per order

requestedBy.description: Operator account no of the requester (for after-sale refunds: 'AFTER_SALE:<no>')

status.description: View status: raw FAILED/CLOSED -> FAILED; CREATED/AWAITING_*/AUTHORIZED/null -> PENDING

bizRef.description: Only for source=ORDER with a biz_no

channel.description: pay_channel; the literal 'null' string if the order has no channel

status.description: Summary: always PENDING. Detail: SETTLED once a SETTLEMENT voucher exists, else PENDING

feeEstimated.description: true when any order is not yet reconciled (fee estimated by shop.pay.fee.estimate-rate-bps)

Summary.description: Range by succeededAt (refunds by refund succeededAt). Unlike list/lookup this includes paid orders regardless of attempt filter but excludes PARTNER source.

matches.description: Rows whose view status is not PENDING/FAILED

pendingNearby.description: PENDING rows in the same window

Lookup.description: Max 50 candidate orders. FAILED rows appear in neither list.

enabled.description: true when the store has at least one ACTIVE pay merchant binding

channels.description: Distinct, sorted channels of ACTIVE bindings

operatorNo.description: Cashier/creator account no; name resolved by the client

kind.description: FAILED/CLOSED carry the raw pay order status

ref.description: Trade no for PAID, failure code for FAILED/CLOSED, payRefundNo for refund events

payerNote.description: Customer note from the scan-to-pay page; standalone near-pay only, always null in embedded deployment
